apps.name: GoatCounter
apps.description: Privacy-friendly web analytics: page views, referrers and screen sizes without tracking people.

screenshots.alt: A week of page views, one chart per page
Total visits, top referrers, browsers and systems

env.desc: Your login, made on the first start

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
# not GOATCOUNTER_*: GoatCounter reads those as its own flags and refuses names it doesn't know
mkdir -p "$HOME/data"
DB="sqlite+$HOME/data/goatcounter.sqlite3"
# make the site and its login before serving: until a site exists, GoatCounter offers anyone a sign-up form
if [ ! -f "$HOME/data/goatcounter.sqlite3" ]; then
  ./goatcounter db create site -createdb -db "$DB" -vhost "$SITE_HOST" -user.email "$GC_ADMIN_EMAIL" -user.password "$GC_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
fi
exec ./goatcounter serve -automigrate -listen "127.0.0.1:$PORT" -tls http -db "$DB"

apps.name: ntfy
apps.description: Push notifications to phones and desktops over plain HTTP PUT/POST. Also a target for nook's own update alerts.

env.desc: read-write, read-only, write-only or deny-all for anyone without a login

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/data/ntfy/attachments"
export NTFY_LISTEN_HTTP="127.0.0.1:$PORT"
export NTFY_BEHIND_PROXY=true
export NTFY_CACHE_FILE="$HOME/data/ntfy/cache.db"
export NTFY_AUTH_FILE="$HOME/data/ntfy/auth.db"
export NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/data/ntfy/attachments"
exec ./ntfy serve

apps.name: PocketBase
apps.description: A backend in one file: a database with realtime subscriptions, auth, file storage and an admin dashboard.

screenshots.alt: The admin dashboard listing records in an orders collection
Editing one record in the admin dashboard

env.desc: Email for the first superuser, made on the first start
Password for the first superuser (at least 8 characters). Change it later in the dashboard.

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
# everything PocketBase keeps lives in data/, which survives updates
D="$HOME/data"
mkdir -p "$D/pb_data" "$D/pb_public" "$D/pb_hooks" "$D/pb_migrations"
flags="--dir=$D/pb_data --publicDir=$D/pb_public --hooksDir=$D/pb_hooks --migrationsDir=$D/pb_migrations"
if [ ! -f "$D/pb_data/.superuser-made" ]; then
  ./pocketbase superuser upsert "$PB_ADMIN_EMAIL" "$PB_ADMIN_PASSWORD" $flags
  touch "$D/pb_data/.superuser-made"
fi
exec ./pocketbase serve --http="127.0.0.1:$PORT" $flags
